_note: Fill in `inputs` using the unit in each _guide entry. Help text may quote SI units; the `unit` field is the one that applies. psig and psia are different: gauge arguments (set_g, back_g ...) are psig, absolute ones psia. Temperatures are readings, not differences.

src.help: unit of the value, e.g. psig, degF, ft, lb/h

dst.help: unit to convert to, e.g. kPag, degC, m, kg/h

across_atmosphere.help: convert between a GAUGE and an ABSOLUTE pressure unit (adds or subtracts 101.325 kPa); refused without this flag

table.help: list every unit, its dimension and the factor to the SI base unit
